title: WALTEUR Debt Ledger
description: A structured register of EVERY knowingly-incurred code-debt marker in the repo. Each suppression (eslint-disable / FIXME / TODO / test.skip / it.only) MUST appear here with an owner, a reason, and a hard expiry date — otherwise it is invisible, unowned, and immortal. The maintainability-gate cross-checks live markers in the source against this ledger and fails on any unrecorded marker. 'id' values MUST be unique across the array.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for this debt item (e.g. DEBT-0007). Must be unique within the ledger.

kind.description: The class of debt marker. 'todo' = a TODO; 'fixme' = a FIXME; 'skip' = a skipped/focused test (test.skip/it.only/xit/describe.skip); 'disable' = a linter suppression (eslint-disable, type: ignore, noqa, etc.).

location.description: Where the marker lives — a repo-relative path, ideally with a line reference (e.g. src/api/users.ts:142).

reason.description: Why the debt exists and what is blocked. Must be a real sentence, not a placeholder — a downstream reviewer should understand the trade-off without reading the code.

owner.description: The single accountable human (handle, email, or name). Debt with no owner is debt that never gets paid.

expires.description: Hard expiry date (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD). After this date the debt is overdue and a downstream gate may escalate. Forces every shortcut to carry a deadline.

issue.description: Optional link to the tracking issue/ticket where the debt is scheduled to be repaid.

created.description: Optional ISO 8601 date the debt was first recorded.
